additional_info.subject: RE: ID0454856-DC/Si-d/DE-[Multi] Screws missing from connector CRM:03056000150
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Frenger,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0454856.
I checked the photos you sent us regarding the missing screws in two plugs.
This is indeed a serious safety hazard that needs to be addressed immediately
. As a matter of fact, if the plugs stayed in the field without screws tightening the mating frame to the plug, it is not guaranteed the IP44 degree of protection, hence I cannot guarantee that any water ingress happened in the plug.
Since a possible water ingress would create an electrical safety risk, and opening the plug to asses any water ingress would compromise the warranty of the plug, I would recommend to replace both plugs, being both the chargers in warranty.
Therefore please:
Let us know which plug on which charger has these missing screws. I will then redirect this ticket to the service colleagues of RC-DE to proceed with the replacement.
Were these plugs recently installed, or were installed in the chargers since the commissioning?
If they were recently installed, the status of the plugs might have been overseen during the installation. Otherwise, the screws might have fallen off during operation and continuous plug/unplug.
Thank you for the feedback. I will forward this ticket to the German service colleagues for replacement.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com

Thank you.
